r.write_text(s, encoding="utf-8", newline="\n")

    while the product session shaped the product document, neither knowing of the other)* →

  *(the user, 2026-10-25)*.
""" + old, 1)
old = "- [ ] The stop stands with `debug` off."
assert x.count(old) == 1
x = x.replace(old, "- [ ] A finding bearing on another running session's question reaches that session as a message\n      pointing at its record, where the host offers one.\n" + old, 1)
t.write_text(x, encoding="utf-8", newline="\n")
